old_description: Network Wiring Contractor Solutions for Your Business & Home in Charleston, sc.
about:
All Wiring Needs operates from Charleston, South Carolina, providing network cabling and telecom brokerage services across the Lowcountry. The company is led by Ruslan, who appears in customer reviews as the primary point of contact for consultations and installations. No founding year or ownership structure is disclosed publicly.

The firm installs Cat5e, Cat6, and Cat6A copper cabling as well as fiber optic lines, deploys wireless access points, and configures routers, switches, and security appliances such as firewalls and VPNs. It also acts as an independent business internet broker, negotiating contracts with carriers including Verizon Business, AT&T Business, Xfinity/Comcast Business, T‑Mobile for Business, and Lumen. Additional services encompass office IT hardware relocation, Wi‑Fi signal assessments, and ongoing IT support.

Customers range from small businesses and managed service providers to residential clients in the Charleston area. Recent projects include a 7,000‑square‑foot office Wi‑Fi deployment, a corporate move requiring same‑day site assessment, home Ethernet wiring, and a security upgrade adding VPN and firewall for an office network.

All Wiring Needs positions itself as an unbiased telecom broker that works for the client rather than the carriers, advertising 15‑30 % savings through exclusive broker deals and full‑cycle support from quote through installation.

name: AllEarth Renewables
old_description: Maximize a full day’s energy potential with AllEarth Renewables’
about:
AllEarth Renewables is based in Bristol, Vermont, where it designs and manufactures dual-axis solar trackers. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but it positions itself as a Vermont solar company serving the Northeast and beyond through a dealer network.

The company's core product is a dual-axis solar tracker that follows the sun's path to increase energy capture. AllEarth describes its trackers as American-designed and manufactured, featuring a simple, robust design with few moving parts to minimize maintenance. A cold-mode function automatically stows the tracker flat when temperatures drop below -10°F to protect components. The company also offers a RePower program to upgrade existing tracker arrays and integrates bifacial solar panels, which its Vermont testing shows can yield 14% more annual electricity than monofacial panels.

AllEarth sells directly to homeowners and businesses in Vermont, while customers outside the state are referred to authorized dealers. Testimonials on its site reference residential installations in Vermont communities such as Monkton, Grand Isle, and Jericho. The company also provides consultation services, including free site assessments and electric bill analysis.

AllEarth emphasizes maximum energy production, claiming its dual-axis trackers produce up to 40% more energy than fixed roof systems. It backs its products with an limited parts warranty and rigorous lifecycle testing, and highlights the tracker's cold-weather resilience and bifacial performance in northern climates as key differentiators.

name: Alliance Parts Warehouse
old_description: Located in North Little Rock, Arkansas, APW leverages the purchasing power of our warehouse
about:
Alliance Parts Warehouse (APW) operates from a 187,000-square-foot facility on 21.9 acres in North Little Rock, Arkansas. The company serves as a cooperative purchasing and redistribution hub for warehouse distributor members across North America. No founding year or ownership details are disclosed.

APW aggregates demand from its member network to purchase over 120 product lines and 35,000 active SKUs in bulk, then redistributes them weekly to more than 100 warehouse locations. The operation runs a paperless, automated warehouse management system (Autopart) with computerized conveyor systems, ten shipping/receiving dock doors, and 24-hour order processing. Weekly stock orders ship in 24–48 hours, with daily expedited special-order service.

The primary customers are independent warehouse distributors in the automotive aftermarket, who consolidate orders through APW to access competitive pricing, small minimum orders, and consolidated freight savings. The product portfolio includes exclusive national brands such as Perfect Stop brakes, supported by marketing programs ranging from point-of-sale materials to technician sweepstakes.

APW was formed to leverage collective buying power and supply-chain cost reductions for its shareholder members, enabling them to compete with larger chains. The company emphasizes 100% EDI capability, a consistent 95% order fill rate, and a single shipping point that simplifies payables for manufacturers.

name: Alliance Sheet Metal & Fabrication
about:
Alliance Sheet Metal & Fabrication operates from Port St. Lucie, Florida, serving the Treasure Coast region including Fort Pierce. The company focuses on sheet metal fabrication and roofing solutions for both commercial and residential projects.

The shop fabricates standing seam metal roofs, custom flashing, ductwork, and other sheet metal components entirely in-house. By controlling production from drawing to delivery, the team aims to reduce lead times and ensure that each piece fits the project specifications without relying on outside vendors.

Primary customers are contractors and builders who need reliable metal roofing packages and fabricated parts for construction projects across the Treasure Coast. The company has supplied stainless steel fabrications and complete roofing systems for commercial buildings and homes alike.

The business emphasizes transparent pricing with accurate takeoffs, a commitment to on-time delivery, and a policy of not overselling more complex systems when simpler ones will suffice. These principles are intended to make the shop a dependable extension of the contractor’s team.

name: Allied Steel Fabricators, Inc
old_description: Michael Exe founded Allied Steel Fabricators, Inc. in 1984. Working out of a 1,200 square foot building, the
about:
Allied Steel Fabricators, Inc. was founded in 1984 by Michael Exe in Redmond, Washington. The company began in a 1,200-square-foot building focusing on structural steel projects. It remains family-owned and operated by the Exe family, with founder Mike Exe's legacy continuing after his passing in 2003.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication including sheet metal laser cutting (with a Trumpf TruLaser 3030 Fiber 6,000-watt system), shearing to 10 feet, sawing, press brake forming up to 12 feet and 325 tons, MIG/TIG and stud welding, finishing (time-saver sanders, prime coating, powder coating, plating), structural steel fabrication with a 6-ton overhead crane and iron workers, handrail fabrication and installation, and custom crating and shipping via two 20-foot trucks. Facility expansions in 1986 and 2003 doubled the footprint, adding a dedicated structural steel building and a larger retail division workspace.

Allied Steel serves architectural, structural steel, retail display, furniture, and custom fabrication markets. Early work on unique structural features attracted corporate display managers from major retailers, to custom display stands for local retailers alongside handrail services for area contractors. The company describes its range as "from earrings to I-beams," producing items from small decorative pieces to large structural assemblies for commercial and residential projects.

The company's stated differentiators are its family-owned consistency, American-made production in Washington, and a motto of "Old World Craftsmanship with Modern Day Style." Its mission emphasizes exceeding customer expectations while fostering employee growth, and its vision targets process and market expansion to insulate stakeholders from economic fluctuations.

name: Allpax
old_description: ProMach Acquires DFT Technology GmbH, a Leading Global Supplier for the Thermal Treatment of Food
about:
Allpax is headquartered in Covington, Louisiana, where it designs and manufactures in-container sterilization and retort room material handling equipment. The company focuses on thermal processing solutions for food, beverage, pharmaceutical, and nutraceutical producers.

Its product line includes production retorts, vacuum-cooled fresh product cookers, substrate sterilizers, R&D retorts, automated batch retort systems, and retort room automation. The company also provides thermal processing services, reconditioning, rebuild, and upgrade services for existing equipment, along with proprietary software and hardware for process control.

Allpax serves industries such as ready-to-drink beverages, food, pet food, nutraceuticals, pharmaceuticals, refrigerated and frozen foods, mushroom fungiculture, and research and development. Its customers range from large-scale food processors to pharmaceutical manufacturers and R&D laboratories seeking validated sterilization systems.

The company’s quality policy emphasizes that equipment must “Work Great, Look Great, and Be Delivered On Time.” A longstanding internal slogan states, “The Customer is the Most Important Person In Our Business,” reflecting a commitment to customer success. Allpax says it differentiates itself by creatively applying advanced hardware and software technology to the pharmaceutical and food-processing industries.

about:
Allwood Machinery operates from Wood-Ridge, New Jersey, serving the greater New York area as a woodworking machinery dealer. The company stocks new and used equipment from European brands including SCM, Morbidelli, Holz, Butfering, and Alfarimini. No founding year or ownership details are disclosed on its website.

The product range centers on air compressors, wide belt sanders, dust collectors, and CNC drilling machines. Featured units include the Holz ZAB 10 rotary screw compressor with integrated dryer and tank, the Butfering Super 43-inch single-head wide belt sander, and the Alfarimini Vortex 440 cyclone dust collector. SCM's Morbidelli cx110 and pwx500 CNC drills are also listed. A service request portal allows customers to schedule repairs by providing machine brand, model, and serial number.

Customers include cabinet shops, furniture makers, and general woodworking facilities. The company's blog tracks material trends such as sustained demand for black walnut alongside white oak and hard maple, and highlights cabinetry directions for 2024, indicating familiarity with the sector's purchasing cycles.

Allwood emphasizes immediate availability — used machinery is marked "In Stock. Ready to Ship" — and backs sales with a dedicated service intake process. Educational content compares compressor technologies to help buyers match equipment to shop requirements.

name: Aloha Lifts, Stairlifts Hawaii
old_description: Your Trusted Partner for Stairlifts and Accessibility Solutions in Hawaii
about:
Aloha Lifts operates from Honolulu, Hawaii, with additional offices in Hilo and Kihei, serving the islands of Oahu, Maui, Hawaii (Big Island), and Kauai. The company was founded to address the mobility needs of the state's aging population, guided by a mission to treat every customer with the Hawaiian values of aloha and respect, welcoming them into the company's ohana, or family.

The firm specializes in the sale and professional installation of accessibility equipment, including indoor and outdoor stairlifts, pool lifts, and vehicle lifts. Its service process follows three steps: an initial consultation to listen and discuss the client's needs, a customized planning phase, and installation scheduled around the customer's availability. Aloha Lifts carries products from manufacturers such as Aqua Creek, notably the Ranger 2 pool lift, and emphasizes that it stands behind every unit it installs.

Primary customers are residential clients seeking to age in place or improve home accessibility across the Hawaiian Islands. The company also works with families and caregivers looking for safe, reliable mobility solutions for loved ones. Its island-wide reach allows it to serve homeowners from Honolulu to rural communities on the Big Island and Kauai.

Aloha Lifts distinguishes itself through a service culture rooted in the concept of ohana, promising friendly, respectful treatment from the first call through final installation. The company offers financing options to make unplanned accessibility needs more affordable and highlights its innovative approach to finding solutions when standard products do not fit a client's situation.

name: Aloha Sheet Metal
old_description: Aloha Sheet Metal LLC has been providing high quality air conditioning services for Maui and All Islands for 20 years.
about:
Aloha Sheet Metal operates from Kihei on the island of Maui, Hawaii, with a fabrication shop in the Pulehunui Industrial Park near Puunene. The family-owned and operated company has provided air conditioning and sheet metal services across Maui and the other Hawaiian islands for approximately 20 years, though a specific founding year is not published.

The company specializes in commercial and light commercial HVAC system installation and design. It runs a complete duct fabrication shop that produces custom ductwork and sheet metal components for its own installations and for outside projects. In addition to new installations, a dedicated service crew handles repairs and maintenance for equipment the company installs as well as for businesses needing HVAC service. Service offerings span air conditioning, heating, kitchen ventilation, and general ventilation systems, with custom sheet metal fabrication available to meet specific design requirements.

Customers include commercial property owners, light commercial businesses, and food-service operators requiring kitchen ventilation on Maui and neighboring islands. The firm works with general contractors and facility managers on new construction and retrofit projects, and it serves any business needing licensed HVAC repair.

Aloha Sheet Metal emphasizes that its in-house fabrication capability shortens lead times and allows parts to be built to exact design specifications, which the company says saves customers time and money. It holds a Hawaii contractor license for both sheet metal and air conditioning work.
